name: GitHub Engagement
summary: Scores activity for each GitHub user who has given consent. You choose the points and daily limit for each activity.
description:
### What it does
Scores activity from users who gave DeepID permission to use their GitHub account.

### How it works
- When the snapshot starts, Reputo saves a fixed copy of activity from the selected repositories for the chosen time period.
- Reputo matches each user to their GitHub account by username. If it cannot find a match, the user gets a score of `0` and is marked as unmatched.
- Each enabled activity earns the points you set. A daily limit sets the maximum number of times each activity is counted for one user on one UTC day.
- A merged pull request counts when it is merged. A review counts when it is submitted. Other activities count when they are created.
- The final score is the total of all points. Reputo does not adjust it to a fixed range unless you use it in Custom Score.
- Bots are not scored. Leave an activity out if you do not want to score it.

### Data used
Activity totals from the selected GitHub repositories and the GitHub usernames that users linked through DeepID.

### Results
- A CSV file with `did`, the `github_engagement` score, and the points earned from each activity.
- A JSON file with activity counts, account match status, and repository coverage for each user.

inputs.label: GitHub account
inputs.description: The connected GitHub account to score. Connect one on the Communities page first.

inputs.label: Repositories
inputs.description: The repositories to include. Pull requests, issues, reviews, and comments in them are scored.

inputs.label: Time period (days)
inputs.description: Number of previous days of activity to include, counted back from when the snapshot starts.

inputs.label: Activity points and limits
inputs.description: Set the points and daily limit for each activity. Points must be above `0`. Leave an activity out if you do not want to score it.

properties.label: Points
properties.description: Points earned each time this activity is counted. Must be above `0`.

properties.label: Daily limit
properties.description: Maximum number of times this activity is counted for one user on one UTC day.

outputs.label: GitHub engagement (CSV)
outputs.description: One row for each user who gave consent, with their score and the points earned from each activity. Users without a matched account have a score of `0`.

columns.description: Final engagement score: the total points earned from all activities.
Points earned from opened pull requests.
Points earned from merged pull requests, credited to the author.
Points earned from submitted pull request reviews.

outputs.label: GitHub engagement details (JSON)
outputs.description: Activity counts, account match status, and repository coverage for each user in the selected time period.
